profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at CoverMyMeds
profile.summary: I’m a sucker for good food, new tech, and dogs!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Full-stack solutioning of Specialty Access & Affordability products, driving high-growth and availability implementations with TypeScript, React, FHIR, Kubernetes, Terraform.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Platform Messaging, Access, and Communications

● Architected and delivered multi-factor authentication (MFA) enforcing compliance requirements for 2.1M+ users across distributed systems, leveraging Okta, OIDC, federated authentication, and JIT provisioning

● Architected a full-stack, OpenID Connect identity provider with Ruby/RoR, Doorkeeper, PostgreSQL

● Acted as Developer Liaison for cloud platform modernization eﬀorts with Azure GitOps, Helm, Docker, and Terraform

● Modernized legacy single sign-on (SSO) microservice using SAML 2.0, Python, Flask, Jinja

● Developed MFA-related support actions for customer support representatives with Elixir, Phoenix, Svelte

● Developed and maintained legacy, full-stack faxing and email services in Ruby/RoR, Sidekiq, Redis

● Developed and maintained legacy authentication and session management services in Ruby/RoR, Sidekiq, Redis

● Acted as designated incident-response representative, participated in on-call rotation for production incidents

● Acted as team security champion, participating in security- and incident-response forums, compliance reviews

● Familiarized and implemented compliance solutions with HIPAA, SOC2, and SOX

● Engaged in self-organized agile engineering practices, leveraging Kanban, Confluence, Jira

positions.title: SEP Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Cybersecurity & Technology Controls, Privileged Access Management

• Facilitated the automation of credential vaulting services and respective Jenkins CI/CD pipelines

• Developed backend RESTful microservices with Java 11, Spring Boot, Open Service Broker (OSB)

• Data and workflow management using Temporal, SQL and NoSQL Databases (e.g. Cassandra, Cockroach)

• Managed private cloud microservices using Kubernetes, Docker, JFrog Artifactory

• Directed initiative to onboard and integrate in-house, testing frameworks (e.g. Serenity, Cucumber)

• Spearheaded development of cross-disciplinary API clients to interface with adjacent internal services

positions.title: SEP Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Successfully participated remotely with management and development teams

• Implemented technological solutions for a local non-profit corporation

• Exposure to software techniques of the Asset and Wealth Management sector

• Participated in organized SCRUM software production techniques

• Utilized Jira, Confluence, BitBucket, and AWS EC2 development tools

• Developed full-stack mobile applications with React Native, Flask, and SQLite

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented customer-facing solutions in payroll and accounting software

• Full stack web-application development utilizing the .NET Framework and AWS

• Skilled development with ASP.NET MVC, C#, jQuery, SQL, and AWS

• Participated in organized software design using the SCRUM framework

• Codebase version control using GitHub, team sprint organization using Jira

projects.title: Buckeye Battles
projects.description: A 3D mini-game developed for an entrepreneurship club using Unreal Engine 4's node system and Blender for asset modeling. The process offered skills in project management, time management, team organization, and technical game creation.

projects.title: Simple Blackjack
projects.description: A traditional blackjack game developed in MATLAB that includes command line input and dynamic card displays
